name: paperclipai/paperclip
type: AI Agent Organization Control Plane / Orchestration
purpose: 開源的 AI agent organization control plane：用目標、org chart、角色、ticket、heartbeat、budget、approval、audit、workspace 與 runtime 管理多個不同供應商的 Agent，讓 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenClaw、CLI/HTTP agents 在同一個治理層下長時間協作。
recommendation: 適合從『同時開很多 Agent 視窗』進一步升級成可治理的 agent organization：不只分派任務，還要管理目標對齊、責任邊界、成本、權限、審批、排程、恢復與稽核。
notes: Official repository confirmed. Paperclip describes itself as open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents and a full control plane rather than a wrapper. Key capabilities include goal ancestry, org charts, ticket/task coordination, heartbeats, persistent agent state, budgets with hard stops, governance/approval gates, scoped secrets, audit logs, multi-organization isolation, runtime skill injection, workspaces and cross-provider agent adapters.

name: Blave-TW/blave-agent
purpose: 開源的 agentic quant workspace，可連接 Claude Code 或 Codex，讓 Agent 將交易想法轉成策略程式、執行回測與研究；實際排程與下單則由 deterministic code / scheduler 執行，而不是把 LLM 放進每次 order loop。專案同時提供 Monte Carlo permutation test、parameter plateau scan、rolling walk-forward、費用檢查、版本一致性標記、kill switch 與 order audit。
recommendation: 適合研究高風險 Agent 系統如何把『LLM 負責研究與產生程式碼』和『deterministic runtime 負責執行』分離，並用統計驗證、版本追蹤、人工 redline、kill switch 與 verify-before-report 降低自動化風險。
notes: Official repository confirmed. README positions Blave Agent as an Agentic Quant Workspace. Notable architecture patterns include no LLM in the order loop, Monte Carlo permutation testing, parameter plateau scanning, rolling walk-forward testing, non-zero fee checks, strategy-code/version consistency flags, user-controlled funding and resume actions, kill switch support, post-write verification, order read-back verification and audit logging. Live trading carries real financial risk; the project explicitly states backtests do not guarantee future results.

name: feitangyuan/onetake
type: Claude Agent Skill / Continuity-driven Motion Film Pipeline
purpose: 用 Agent 產生一鏡到底的產品發布片、teaser 與 feature demo：把每個 beat 的交界當成主要設計問題，要求畫面元素從上一段持續存在並轉化成下一段，搭配單一連續鏡頭、HTML 重建 UI、deterministic motion、motion blur、聲音事件與自動 continuity oracle 驗收。
recommendation: 適合產品 launch video、功能展示與 AI 動效影片，尤其是想避免『每一鏡都好看，但串起來像 PPT』的情境；也很適合研究如何把創意原則轉成可量測的 acceptance criteria。
notes: Official repository confirmed. OneTake is an Agent Skill centered on continuity-driven motion: every boundary must carry something visibly into the next beat, with automated verification before human review. It rebuilds product UI in HTML, uses deterministic motion primitives, motion blur and event-driven sound. License is PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; commercial use is not permitted.

name: electron/electron
type: Cross-platform Desktop Application Runtime / Web-to-Desktop Shell
purpose: 讓既有 JavaScript、HTML、CSS 前端技術直接用來建立 macOS、Windows、Linux 桌面應用。Electron 把 Chromium renderer 與 Node.js-powered main process 組合在同一個 runtime，由 main process 管理視窗、生命週期與 native desktop APIs，renderer 負責 Web UI，並透過 preload、contextBridge 與 IPC 建立受控的權限橋接。
recommendation: 適合已有 Web 技術棧、想快速建立跨平台桌面 App，或需要把 React／HTML UI 接到檔案系統、系統選單、通知、tray、視窗與其他 native desktop capability 的專案。
notes: Official repository and docs confirmed. Electron is built on Chromium and Node.js and ships cross-platform binaries for macOS, Windows and Linux. Its architecture separates privileged main process from renderer processes; preload/contextBridge/IPC should be used as a narrow capability boundary. Security guidance recommends disabling Node integration for remote content, keeping context isolation and sandboxing enabled, validating IPC senders and not exposing privileged Electron APIs to untrusted content. MIT licensed.

name: XiaoPuOuO/openchatx-mcp
type: Local Agent Runtime / MCP Capability Gateway
purpose: 把一般 ChatGPT Chat 當作模型與 planner，將 coding-grade 檔案／shell 工具、電腦控制、MCP aggregation、Toolboxes、Skills、Rules、Projects、Tasks、Subagents 與跨 session Summaries 放在本機 runtime，透過一個官方 MCP 連線提供給 ChatGPT 使用。外部 MCP 與 Toolbox schemas 採 lazy exposure，避免所有工具定義一次塞進 context。
recommendation: 適合想把 ChatGPT 變成可操作本機專案與工具的 Agent，但不想自己從零打造 agent runtime、MCP gateway、Skills／Rules 載入、跨 session handoff 與本機管理介面的情境。
notes: Official repository confirmed. OpenChatX uses the documented MCP path and OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel rather than reverse engineering ChatGPT. The tunnel is outbound-only, so the local MCP server does not require a public inbound listener. OpenChatX keeps ChatGPT as the model/planner and acts as the local tool/runtime layer. Cross-session Summaries store a compacted older summary plus recent useful context and return a UUID handoff for a fresh conversation. The runtime can execute commands, edit files, use connected MCP servers and control supported applications with the local user's permissions, so tool trust and permission boundaries matter. MIT licensed.

name: ChatCut
type: Conversational AI Video Editor / Agent-native NLE
purpose: 把自然語言指令轉成真正可編輯的多軌 timeline 操作：可做初剪、刪除停頓與 filler words、文字稿剪輯、字幕、B-roll、AI 影片／圖片／音樂／旁白與 motion graphics。所有變更落在正常 clips、tracks 與 captions 上，而不是只輸出不可修改的模板影片。
recommendation: 適合先用 Agent 快速完成粗剪、文字稿整理、字幕與素材生成，再把 timeline 以 FCP7 XMEML XML 交給 DaVinci Resolve 做調色、音訊、效果與最終 mastering；ChatCut 也提供 DaVinci Resolve 專用 XML export preset。
notes: Official ChatCut docs confirmed. ChatCut provides web, desktop and Agent Plugin surfaces over the same editable multi-track project. XML export uses FCP7 XMEML and explicitly offers a DaVinci Resolve preset; some elements such as captions, GIFs, certain graphics/effects/transitions may not transfer and need to be rebuilt in the destination NLE. Motion graphics can also be exported as ProRes 4444 with alpha for use in DaVinci Resolve and other NLEs.

name: pbakaus/impeccable
type: Cross-Harness Frontend Design Skill / UI Quality System
purpose: 把前端設計 guidance、產品脈絡、browser iteration 與 UI 品質檢查封裝成一個跨 coding-agent harness 的 Skill。提供 24 個設計命令、live browser iteration、61 個 deterministic detector rules，以及 PRODUCT.md / DESIGN.md 分層，讓 Agent 能先理解產品真實需求，再做 shape、critique、audit、polish、animate、layout、typeset 等設計工作。
recommendation: 適合 AI coding 產生的前端容易落入模板化視覺、層級混亂、a11y／responsive／edge cases 不完整，或你希望 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Hermes 等不同 harness 共用同一套設計 vocabulary 與驗收流程的專案。
notes: Official repository confirmed. Impeccable provides one reusable design skill, 24 commands, live browser iteration and 61 deterministic detector rules for AI-generated frontend design. /impeccable init records durable product truth in PRODUCT.md while visual direction/design-system information lives separately in DESIGN.md. Deterministic CLI/browser checks run without an LLM or API key; LLM critique is used for judgments that cannot be reduced to rules. It supports multiple coding-agent harnesses and provider-native hooks where available.

name: luckdvr/photo-riso-poster
type: Evidence-first Image Generation Skill / Riso Poster
purpose: 把照片或文字主題轉成安靜的 risograph archive poster。對照片先抽取可觀察事實，例如數量、間距、遮擋、方向、深度與色彩角色，再把這些 evidence 映射成 2–3 色套印、留白、紙張冷暖與排印資訊；生成階段使用文字化 evidence，而不是把原照片直接交給 image generation。
recommendation: 適合需要從真實照片產生有固定視覺語法、但又不想只是做一般 style transfer 的海報；也適合研究如何把『看圖』拆成 evidence extraction → visual mapping → constrained generation → self-check 的可重用 Skill。
notes: Official repository and SKILL.md confirmed. The skill is a single prompt document with no scripts or bundled assets and requires an image-capable assistant; the Codex install uses its built-in image generation tool. It supports faithful / standard / minimal abstraction levels. Core rules include mapping every output mark to a source fact, preserving relational invariants, using source-derived 2–3 ink roles, matching paper temperature to the source, preserving source aspect orientation, and regenerating once when key output constraints fail. MIT licensed.

name: github/gh-aw
type: Agentic CI/CD Workflow Compiler / GitHub Actions Runtime
purpose: 用 Markdown + YAML frontmatter 定義需要推理的 repository automation，再由 gh-aw CLI 驗證並編譯成標準 GitHub Actions workflow。適合 issue triage、PR review、CI failure investigation、文件維護、dependency analysis 與 repository reporting；deterministic build/test/lint/deploy 仍保留在一般 GitHub Actions。
recommendation: 適合想把 Agent 正式納入 GitHub repository workflow，而不是用長時間本機 session 手動跑任務的情境；尤其適合需要事件觸發、可重現 workflow artifact、模型可替換，以及把 Agent 寫入動作限制在受控權限邊界內的專案。
notes: Official repository confirmed. gh-aw compiles Markdown agentic workflows into GitHub Actions. Built-in engines include GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Gemini and Pi. The supported agent-job path is read-only and sandboxed by default; configured writes are normally buffered as safe outputs, validated, and applied in separate jobs with scoped permissions. The project explicitly positions agentic workflows as a complement to deterministic CI/CD, not a replacement. README also notes a historical security advisory affecting retired releases >=0.83.3 and <0.85.4; current version should be verified before deployment.

name: vectorize-io/hindsight
purpose: 替 Agent 建立可持續累積的長期記憶與學習層，不只保存對話歷史。核心操作是 retain、recall、reflect；以 memory banks 隔離不同使用者／專案脈絡，並把記憶整理成 observations、mental models 與 knowledge pages。提供 server、embedded、cloud、SDK、MCP，以及 coding agents / agent frameworks 等多種整合。
recommendation: 適合需要 Agent 跨 session 持續記住專案與使用者脈絡，並把大量 episodic facts 逐步整理成可重用 mental model，而不是每次只做向量檢索或把完整歷史重新塞進 context 的系統。
notes: Official repository confirmed. Hindsight positions itself as a memory system focused on agents that learn over time. It exposes retain / recall / reflect, memory banks, observations, mental models and knowledge pages; supports self-hosted, embedded and managed deployment plus many coding-agent/framework integrations. The README reports state-of-the-art LongMemEval results and says Hindsight's benchmark performance was independently reproduced by Virginia Tech collaborators and The Washington Post; benchmark numbers are project-reported here rather than independently revalidated in this collection. MIT licensed.

name: cyyeh/jit-learning-loop
type: Cross-Harness Learn-While-Doing Agent Skill / Cognitive Scaffolding
purpose: 把 coding agent 從『替你把任務做完』改成『在完成真實工程任務時，把可轉移的認知工作逐步交還給你』。流程先校準 assistance level，將未知拆成 concept / API / codebase / behavior，建立最小 mental model；在實驗前要求 prediction，再實作、解釋 diff 的 invariants / failure modes、用 transfer questions 檢查理解，最後留下 1–3 個可重用 lessons。
recommendation: 適合第一次接觸新框架、系統或 codebase，但仍要把實際 bug / feature 做完的情境；特別適合避免 Agent 變成永久代辦，透過 guided → shared → review 的 fading 讓使用者在同一主題上逐步接回設計、判斷與實作責任。
notes: Official repository and SKILL.md confirmed. The skill implements a just-in-time learning loop inside production coding work rather than turning the task into a course. It uses two deliberate human checkpoints: prediction before evidence/experiments and transfer-oriented comprehension checks after implementation. It distinguishes concept, API, codebase and behavior unknowns because each needs a different learning/diagnostic strategy, and uses assistance fading across guided, shared and review levels. It supports Agent Skills-compatible coding agents including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot and OpenCode. Apache-2.0 licensed.

name: zhaoxuya520/reverse-skill
purpose: 替 AI coding agents 提供逆向工程、授權滲透測試與安全研究的任務路由層：先做 scope / authorization gate，再依 APK、binary、JS、mobile、malware、firmware、CTF、API、LLM security 等情境選擇對應 Skill、工具、MCP 與腳本，並保留 evidence、timeline、finding 與 field journal。
recommendation: 適合研究大量專業 Skills 如何用結構化 routing、tool availability 檢查與 regression benchmark 管理，而不是讓 Agent 每次臨場猜要用哪套工具；安全操作仍應限定在合法授權範圍。
notes: Official repository confirmed. Reverse Skill is a client-neutral cybersecurity skills router pack. Its documented workflow routes tasks through global rules and a primary routing layer, initializes scope and authorization before target actions, checks local tool availability, dispatches to scenario-specific skills, and records evidence / findings / timeline / field journal. The routing configuration is treated as a source of truth and is covered by cross-platform regression/coherence checks. MIT licensed.

name: greensock/gsap-skills
type: Official Cross-Harness Web Animation Skill Pack
purpose: 由 GSAP 官方維護的 Agent Skills，將 GSAP core API、timeline、ScrollTrigger、plugins、utils、React、performance 與 Vue/Svelte 等 framework integration 拆成 8 個可重用 Skill，讓 coding agents 能正確產生入場、轉場、scroll-linked animation、互動與 lifecycle cleanup。
recommendation: 適合 landing page、產品網站與互動式前端，尤其是需要 timeline sequencing、ScrollTrigger、Flip / MotionPath 等可程式化 motion，而不是只靠模型猜動畫 API 的情境。
notes: Official GreenSock repository confirmed. The pack follows the Agent Skills format and documents support for multiple coding agents through skills CLI / agent-specific adapters. It contains eight skills covering core GSAP, timelines, ScrollTrigger, plugins, utilities, React, performance and other frameworks. MIT licensed.

name: wshuyi/research-to-diagram
purpose: 從一個 topic / research question 出發，自動進行多輪研究、記錄來源、抽取與整理知識關係、選擇 diagram 結構，再用 Graphviz 產生可編輯 DOT 與向量 PDF；適合人物關係、技術架構、歷史事件與 concept map。
recommendation: 適合把『研究』與『關係視覺化』接成同一條可追溯流程，而不是先產生一篇摘要再人工重畫圖；尤其適合需要 reference links 與可修改 diagram source 的研究型產物。
notes: Official repository confirmed. The documented workflow is planning → multi-round web research → knowledge extraction → structure / layout design → Graphviz DOT generation → vector PDF → source documentation. The project provides editable .dot output and reference links; speed/accuracy claims in its README are project-reported rather than independently validated here. MIT licensed.

name: coreyhaines31/marketingskills:copywriting
purpose: 把網站與 landing page copywriting 變成有產品脈絡的 Agent workflow：先讀取持久化 product-marketing context，再補齊 page purpose、audience、offer、traffic source 與 proof，之後依 clarity、benefit、specificity、customer language、page structure 與 CTA 原則產生或改寫文案。
recommendation: 適合產品首頁、landing page、pricing / feature page 與 value proposition；比單次『幫我寫得有說服力』更適合建立可重複的產品行銷寫作流程。
notes: Official source is the copywriting skill inside coreyhaines31/marketingskills. The skill reads persisted product-marketing context when available, asks only for missing task-specific information, emphasizes clarity over cleverness, customer language, benefits, specificity, page structure and action-oriented CTA, and explicitly warns against fabricated proof. Repository is MIT licensed.

name: larashero3-dotcom/lieflat-less-ai-tone
purpose: 在成稿後用明確 whitelist 規則辨識與改寫常見 AI writing tells，只處理命中的模式；沒有命中規則的文字必須保留，也不能任意重組整篇文章，以降低『去 AI 味』過度改寫原意與作者聲音的風險。
recommendation: 適合把 humanize / 去 AI 味從模糊的風格要求改成可檢查的 editing pass；尤其適合希望保留原文結構與內容，只清理特定 AI 套話或語氣模式的情境。
notes: Official SKILL.md confirmed. The skill explicitly uses a whitelist of detectable AI-writing patterns and requires unmatched text to remain untouched; it is intended as a post-draft cleanup pass rather than a full rewrite. This makes the transformation boundary explicit and auditable.

name: op7418/guizang-product-video-skill
type: Source-Grounded Product Video Agent Skill / Code-Rendered Media Pipeline
purpose: 從產品 codebase、近期 commit / release notes 與既有 design language 出發，整理值得講的更新、寫分鏡與文案、優先掛載真實產品元件，再用 GSAP / code-driven animation、配樂、動作音效與 FFmpeg/render pipeline 產出 MP4 與可繼續修改的工程。
recommendation: 適合產品 launch / changelog / feature promo，尤其是需要影片『看起來就是這個產品』而不是生成一套假的 UI；也適合研究 source code / design system 如何成為媒體生成的 ground truth。
notes: Official repository confirmed. The workflow starts from product scope, code and real components, derives multiple visual directions, builds scenes with GSAP and code-rendered UI, adds original/programmatic music and action-aligned sound effects, reviews contact sheets/transitions/full-size frames, then exports an MP4 plus editable project and provenance/check records. Supports Claude Code and Codex. AGPL-3.0 licensed.
